q1_issues.issue: "the last elm" is encoded as the plain property (Member sk_elm_1 last), but the Ordinal construction explicitly covers this shape ("the last runner") and requires (Ordinal <entity> last <scale>), so a rank is recorded here as class membership.

"that autumn" is minted as the coined constant that_autumn, whereas the anaphoric-temporal rule resolves "that <time>" by copying the antecedent's calendar terms and, with no antecedent present, leaves only the bare part symbol; the licensed bare constants are the this / last / next deictics, not "that N".

q2_gaps: season-granularity time — the structured Time terms are Year / Month / Day / Weekday / Hour / Minute with no season constructor, and the anaphoric term-propagation rule is written only for day-level parts (that evening / day / night), so an antecedent-less "that autumn" has no specified form
notes: Patient for the intransitive change-of-state subject and the absence of a status atom for the bare simple present are both correct.
